briefings.title: AI in Banking: Risk and Reward | Bloomberg Tech: Europe 10/9/2026
briefings.tldr: AI deployment in banking has accelerated dramatically—jumping 26% on the Evident index in the past year—while introducing severe systemic cybersecurity risks (such as AI "mythos" threats) and prompting firms like JPMorgan, Revolut, and Bending Spoons to radically reshape their workforces, products, and tech stacks.

briefings.title: JPMorgan CEO Jamie Dimon Says India Will Find It Harder To Stay Non-Aligned | Exclusive | CNBC TV18
briefings.tldr: JPMorgan CEO Jamie Dimon warns that India will find it increasingly difficult to remain non-aligned amid rising geopolitical tensions, while urging Washington and New Delhi to conclude a stalled trade agreement.

briefings.title: Private Credit's Clock is Ticking w/ Glenn Schorr & Ken Worthington | The Real Eisman Playbook Ep 72
briefings.tldr: Steve Eisman, joined by Glenn Schorr of Evercore and Ken Worthington of JP Morgan, explores the looming refinancing crunch in private credit software loans, the mechanics of retail broker cash yield optimization via agentic AI, crypto use cases versus Bitcoin’s store-of-value thesis, and a booming second-quarter earnings season for major investment banks.
